column4: Finding
`Ids` is nullable, but the action enumerates it without checking. A request with `Ids: null` causes a `NullReferenceException` instead of a validation response.

Approvals are applied one at a time. If a later ID fails, earlier approvals may already have taken effect while the request returns an error; retrying the whole batch can then encounter already-approved invoices.
